newsitem.title: CHINA: China coastal areas Q1 foreign investment down.
newsitem.headline: China coastal areas Q1 foreign investment down.

text.p: Direct foreign investment in 18 of China's coastal and border regions decreased in the first quarter of 1997 compared with the year-ago period, the China Business Daily said on Friday.

Eleven regions saw direct foreign investment plummet by more than 50 percent, including northern Hebei province by 91 percent, eastern Shandong province by 91 percent, eastern Zhejiang province by 89 percent, southern Guangxi region by 85 percent and southern Guangdong province by 80 percent, the newspaper said.
It did not give a dollar figure or say why foreign investment shrank.

Guangdong topped the list in terms of actual foreign investment, attracting $2.03 billion, followed by eastern Jiangsu province luring $1.06 billion, Shanghai $950 million and southeastern Fujian province $900 million, the newspaper said without giving comparative figures.
